en: A black-and-white postcard view of a broad, tree-lined street bordered by early 20th‑century buildings. On the right side is a brick building with a large sign reading "PALLADIUM" above a cinema or theater entrance; pedestrians and bicycles line the sidewalk. The left side shows lower wooden and masonry shopfronts. Benches and a walkway run along the tree row in the center. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and a photographer/publisher imprint at the bottom right.
